objective: Definir el contrato puro del expediente contractual/documental de Cavas, sin DDL, sin almacenamiento binario propio y sin inventar un sistema criptografico de firma. Debe preservar versiones de documentos, aceptaciones/consentimientos, recibos, autorizaciones y cronologia documental por contrato/periodo. Los documentos son referencias canonicas externas al dominio; Cavas valida metadatos y trazabilidad, no custodia criptografia ni duplica repositorios documentales.

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    ContractDocumentKind,
    ContractDocumentVersion,
    DocumentAcceptanceEvidence,
    DocumentAcceptanceKind,
    is_acceptance_active,
    validate_contract_document_version,
    validate_document_acceptance_evidence,
)


def test_document_version_uses_external_reference_not_binary_payload():
    doc = ContractDocumentVersion(
        document_version_id="DOCV-1", contract_id="CTR-1", contract_period_id="PER-1",
        kind=ContractDocumentKind.CONTRATO, version_label="v1",
        document_reference="DOCREF-123", effective_from="2026-01-01",
    )
    validate_contract_document_version(doc)
    assert "binary_content" not in ContractDocumentVersion.__dataclass_fields__


def test_document_version_preserves_supersession_history():
    validate_contract_document_version(ContractDocumentVersion(
        document_version_id="DOCV-2", contract_id="CTR-1", contract_period_id="PER-2",
        kind=ContractDocumentKind.CONTRATO, version_label="v2", document_reference="DOCREF-456",
        effective_from="2027-01-01", supersedes_document_version_id="DOCV-1",
    ))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_contract_document_version(ContractDocumentVersion(
            document_version_id="DOCV-X", contract_id="CTR-1", contract_period_id=None,
            kind=ContractDocumentKind.ANEXO, version_label="v1", document_reference="DOCREF-X",
            effective_from="2026-01-01", supersedes_document_version_id="DOCV-X",
        ))


def test_acceptance_requires_actor_time_and_evidence():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_document_acceptance_evidence(DocumentAcceptanceEvidence(
            acceptance_id="ACC-1", document_version_id="DOCV-1",
            acceptance_kind=DocumentAcceptanceKind.ACEPTACION, actor_reference="CLI-1",
            accepted_at="2026-01-01T12:00:00", evidence_reference="",
        ))


def test_revocation_preserves_original_acceptance_and_requires_reason():
    active = DocumentAcceptanceEvidence(
        acceptance_id="ACC-1", document_version_id="DOCV-1",
        acceptance_kind=DocumentAcceptanceKind.CONSENTIMIENTO, actor_reference="CLI-1",
        accepted_at="2026-01-01T12:00:00", evidence_reference="EVID-1",
    )
    assert is_acceptance_active(active) is True
    revoked = DocumentAcceptanceEvidence(
        acceptance_id="ACC-2", document_version_id="DOCV-1",
        acceptance_kind=DocumentAcceptanceKind.CONSENTIMIENTO, actor_reference="CLI-1",
        accepted_at="2026-01-01T12:00:00", evidence_reference="EVID-2",
        revoked_at="2026-02-01T12:00:00", revocation_reason="Revocacion documentada",
    )
    assert is_acceptance_active(revoked) is False


def test_domain_does_not_implement_cryptographic_signature():
    assert "signature_private_key" not in DocumentAcceptanceEvidence.__dataclass_fields__
    assert "signed_binary" not in DocumentAcceptanceEvidence.__dataclass_fields__
